notes.title: Story mode available now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Our game has received a major update—introducing [Story Mode]!

✨Features
· Lower the difficulty of mini-games and allows skipping the forest exploration. However, rewards will be reduced (this does not affect the story ending). Ideal for players who want to focus on the story or for a second playthrough.
· Players in the progress can switch mode without replay the game from start.
· Accessible via Items > Manuscript.


We hope this update enhances your gaming experience, and we look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: English play test for "Escape from the Cursed Convent"
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are excited to announce that the play test for "Escape from the Cursed Convent" is now live!
We’ve been polishing the english version of the game, and we are now looking for around 10 enthusiastic english testers to help us proof reading and bug testing the game via steam.

It's a narrative & adventure game comes with several minigames, includes minor violence and yuri content. The entire gameplay takes around 4 to 5 hours.

Requirements :
- finish the game and feedback form before June 30th
- gathered the bug infos to word or other documentation application if possible

Feel free to [url=https://forms.gle/vGSp6D1JMEBJPwjG6]sign up the form[/url] if you're interested!

Thank you for your support,
Ais Kacang Studio
